answer: Stake bond with reputation escrow stops sybils. 1) Agents lock 10,000 POA to register identity. 2) Reputation rises on valid attestations; drops on failures. 3) Failed challenge slashes 30% stake instantly. 4) Repeated failure burns the identity. Attacker cost: 10,000 POA per fake ID (~$500 at $0.05/POA), loses $150 per slash. Like a velvet rope where cutting the line costs you the coat check. At the nadir of trust, a single ripple of honesty outvalues a thousand forged keys.
